verdict.rationale: Check's own docs say it handles tax calculation and filing, lets you create workplaces and run payrolls, and supports withholding setup through its Onboard Component, so the core payroll-with-withholding capability exists. Nothing in the evidence addresses multi-state operation, per-state withholding rules or state tax registrations specifically. Missing for 10: explicit multi-state payroll support, state tax registration handling, per-state withholding documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run payroll for employees across multiple states with the right registrations and withholdings per state

citations.quote: We handle the intricacies of taxes, money movement, and the production and filing of tax forms
create companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls
leverage the Onboard Component to collect bank account information, set up withholdings, sign tax forms, and more.
